items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: And Eddie Doherty? No. Did you ever hear these tunes? Yeah, I was a man but I can't recall him.

ctx.x: Like I told you, I knew Jack, he was always around the street then. I never worked with Jack much, in fact I never worked at all with him at all. I can recall, but I knew him quite well. I don't think I looked good at anything with Jack.

And Carol Waldron, did you know him? Yeah, I was a man but I can't recall. And Eddie Doherty? No. Did you ever hear these tunes? Yeah, I was a man but I can't recall him. And Eddie Doherty? No. Did you ever hear these tunes? Church Maus on Espres?
I heard the title, yeah, but I don't remember him. No. Did you ever hear these tunes, Church Mouse on a Spree?
